text: The Palace Pier is about 525 metres long. If you walk to the end and back, how far have you walked?
why: There and back is twice the length: 2 × 525 = 1,050 metres.

text: Which part of the city is hidden in this sentence: 'He dug the sand with a shovel'?
The i360 pod leaves on the hour and every half hour. You arrive at 3:45. How many minutes until the next one?
why: After 3:30 the next pod leaves at 4:00, which is 15 minutes after 3:45.

text: How many different letters do the words BRIGHTON and HOVE have in common?
why: BRIGHTON has B, R, I, G, H, T, O, N and HOVE has H, O, V, E: only H and O are shared.

text: In BRIGHTON AND HOVE ALBION, how many different letters appear exactly once?
why: R, G, T, D, V, E and L appear once; B, I, H and A appear twice, and O and N three times.
